notes.title: That Role Playing New Update
notes.content:
In this Update v1.77 we added the Game Menu with Music volume and Sound volume controls, Loud sounds amplification control, Fullscreen modes and Language switching, general multi-language support and one extra language (Russian), Instructions information dialog, way to skip printing of long messages and (surprise!) Mouse controls for all and everything in the game.

After Autumn Sale 2021 a new Ramble game mode is planned to be added with procedurally generated maps and new monsters. Along with a new starting location, special far sight rendering and more languages. And a new price. Stay tuned!

notes.title: UPDATE v1.77 Released
notes.content:
UPDATE v1.77 Patch Notes:

+ Added Game Menu, call by Esc key or Mouse Right Click

+ Added Music volume and Sound volume controls
+ Added Loud sounds amplification control
+ Added Fullscreen mode control
+ Added Multi-Language support
+ Added Russian language, more to come

+ Added Instructions dialog with important information
+ Added Restart and Quit confirmation dialogs
+ Added extra shortcut keys: F1 for Instructions, R for restart

+ Added Mouse control: Left Click for actions, Right Click for cancel/menu
+ Added way to skip printing of long messages with any action key
  
+ Increased maximal length of Hero name to 12
+ Refined Shields amount display
+ Refined Game Panel display

notes.title: That Role Playing Update!
notes.content:
In this Update we enlarged exploration distance to avoid stumbling, added Death Hints to help players better understand critical nuances in combat mechanics and added Puzzle Hints to help solve all text puzzles, which turned to be quite challenging for almost all players. We also fixed couple of minor bugs.

Before forthcoming Steam Autumn Sale 2021 discount we plan to add in-game ESC menu, How to Play instructions and one additional language.

After the sale a new lesser game mode will be added with procedurally generated maps and new monsters. Watch out for new Updates!

notes.title: UPDATE v1.37 Released
notes.content:
UPDATE v1.37 Patch Notes:

+ Enlarged exploration distance to avoid stumbling situations

+ Added Death Hints to help understanding combat mechanics
+ Added Solve Hints to help solve text puzzles

+ Now monsters don't move and don't attack when you reading messages or writing answers
+ Now Spiders not always perform retaliation attack after you attacked them

* Fixed secret ending minor bug

notes.title: That Role Playing got Released!
notes.content:
As you maybe noticed we released [b]That Role Playing[/b] and now you may play to:
[list]
[*] Explore interesting areas
[*] Fight Bats, meet Goblins and say hello to Trolls
[*] Gain enough Health and Armour to finish your Quest
[*] Solve all Puzzles to obtain Legendary Crystals
[*] Survive among the Spiders
[*] Meet Queen of Forest
[*] Return back
[/list]
There are also more to do:
[list]
[*] Find and experience The Mystery
[*] Collect all Steam Achievements
[/list]
And maybe find an alternative Secret Ending...


"May the Life Force be with you!"

[b]EyeZary Games Developers Team[/b]
